items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I was with him before he had that band. That was with the Palmer Brothers and Kirby.

ctx.x: was... I was with him before he had that band. That was with the Palmer Brothers and Kirby.
When were you with the Palmer Brothers?
This is ancient. That was '31, '32... That would be in between there. It didn't happen, but we tried to make it. We played a few hotel dates and... But it didn't come off.
